items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...when Roosevelt was elected... [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember anything about a parade.

ctx.x: stayed there, and they started (inaudible). There was Charlie, Jerry and Deke, and then they went down to Cincinatti and got Hoppy (phonetic spelling) and then they went onto New York and went on from there and that's how the original Inkspots were born.
Why weren't you able to get any more jobs? Didn't you tell me that you were playing up in Albany when Roosevelt was elected and they had the inaugural parade, or something?
I don't remember anything about a parade.
